title: sim_finalize HMAC/hash distinction via keySz>0 is implicit state
description: sim_finalize (sim.c:427-431) distinguishes HMAC from plain hash by checking slot->keySz>0. This is implicit: a future INIT path that sets a key for a non-HMAC operation would incorrectly route to sim_finalize_hmac. Suggested rewrite: add an explicit SIM_OP_HMAC sub-type (distinct from SIM_OP_HASH) set during sim_ioctl_init when algo starts with 'hmac('. This makes the dispatch self-documenting and immune to accidental key presence in other ops.
